handover_report.title: EverythingAI — Source Path Watcher Resume Validated
completed_scope: Added resumePersistedWatchers for restarting active source-path watchers after backend restart.
Server startup now bootstraps persisted active watchers after the API starts listening.
Stopped watch roots are not resumed.
Failed watcher resumes are reported without blocking remaining active paths.
Missing watch roots are marked failed instead of silently continuing.
Fixed test watch-root ID generation to use full SHA-256 path hash and avoid primary-key collisions.
